base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019", T1."XCL_020" FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN race AS T3 ON T1."XCL_025" = T3."XCL_016"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female' AND T3."XCL_017" = 'Human' AND T1."XCL_028" > 170 AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T4."XCL_012") > 10
ORDER BY T5."XCL_011" DESC

SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN 
    race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
JOIN 
    hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN 
    attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
JOIN 
    hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE 
    g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
    AND r.XCL_017 = 'Human'
    AND s.XCL_028 > 170
    AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
GROUP BY 
    s.XCL_018
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.XCL_013) > 10
ORDER BY 
    ha.XCL_011 DESC
